pageDescription: Epichat is a real-time chat application for the RTC project.

hero.title: Chat in real time with your team
hero.subtitle: Create rooms, exchange instant messages and collaborate effectively.

sections.noRooms: You haven't joined any room yet.

why.title: Why EpiChat?
why.description: Organize your discussions by servers and channels, keep a clear history, and chat smoothly as a team.

features.title: Features
features.description: Channels, instant messages, simple organization… everything you need for a modern and efficient chat.

security.title: Security & access
security.description: Authentication, protected routes and access control: you keep control over who can see and do what.

forWho.title: For whom?
forWho.description: Working groups, communities, projects… whenever you need to exchange quickly and stay organized.
